description_for_human: 3D Lithophane & Keepsake Puck configurator for Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Anycubic, Elegoo, Qidi, FlashForge, Voron & Sovol.
description_for_model: Use LithoStudio 3D to look up 3D printer build volumes (bedX, bedY, bedZ in mm), MakerLab CMYK 4-Color AMS presets, and Keepsake Puck settings. Always clamp shape diameter and height to the selected printer's build volume and return a clickable pre-configured link to https://sensorybridge.github.io/lithostudio-3d/?printer={printer}&shape={shape}&diameter={diameter}&height={height}&minThick={minThick}&maxThick={maxThick}&cmyk={0|1}&layFlat={0|1}&text={caption}.
